variantrule.name: Firearms (Gunslinger)
entries: Ranged weapons built from alchemical powder, rare metals and controlled explosive force — new, volatile, and carrying weapon properties of their own.
These properties replace the optional firearm rules in the Dungeon Master's Guide; look up Firearms [DMG] for those.

entries.name: Proficiency
entries: Firearm proficiency is not granted by ordinary martial training. A Gunslinger has it from level 3; anyone else can fire one, but their misfire score is 1 worse.

entries.name: The properties
entries: Reload N. Fires N times before you spend one attack or one action reloading it, with a free hand.
Misfire N. An attack roll of N or lower misses and jams the weapon.
Explosive. On a hit, everything within 5 feet of the target is caught in the blast.
Each has its own entry: look up Reload, Misfire or Explosive.

entries.name: Ammunition
entries: Every firearm takes its own, and none of them can attack without it. Look up Firearm Ammunition.

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play. The weapons themselves are stocked in the item library.

variantrule.name: Reload
entries: Firearm property. The weapon fires a number of times equal to its reload score before it must be reloaded.

entries.name: Reloading
entries: Costs one attack or one action, and needs one free hand.
A Gunslinger of level 15 or higher reloads any firearm as a bonus action instead (Lightning Reload).

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play.

variantrule.name: Misfire
entries: Firearm property. Whenever you make an attack roll with a firearm and the d20 comes up equal to or lower than the weapon's misfire score, the attack misses and the weapon jams.

entries.name: Clearing a jam
entries: The weapon cannot be used again until you spend an action repairing it: a Tinker's Tools check against DC 8 + the weapon's misfire score.
A Gunslinger of level 10 or higher can do it for 1 grit as a bonus action instead (Rapid Repair).

entries.name: If the check fails
entries: The weapon is broken, and must be mended out of combat at a quarter of the firearm's cost.

entries.name: Firing one untrained
entries: A creature with no firearm proficiency raises that weapon's misfire score by 1.

entries.name: Raising it on purpose
entries: Two trick shots trade reliability for effect: Piercing Shot adds 1 to the misfire score, and Violent Shot adds 2 for every grit point spent.

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play.

variantrule.name: Explosive
entries: Firearm property. On a hit, every creature within 5 feet of the target makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d8 fire damage.

entries.name: The save
entries: DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: On a miss
entries: The round fails to detonate, or bounces away harmlessly. Nothing in the blast radius is affected.

entries.name: Which firearm
entries: The Hand Mortar: 2d8 fire, 30/60 ft., reload 1, misfire 3, and crafted rather than bought.

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play.

variantrule.name: Firearm Ammunition
entries: Every firearm takes its own ammunition, and none of them can attack without it.

entries.name: Buying it
entries: Rare enough that a shop may simply not have any. Each kind is sold in the batch size below.

entries.name: Crafting it
entries: With materials and Tinker's Tools you can make your own at half the listed cost. A Gunslinger has the tool proficiency from level 3 (Gunsmith).

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play. Each batch is stocked in the item library beside its weapon.

variantrule.name: Grit
entries: A Gunslinger's fuel for trick shots.

entries.name: How many
entries: Grit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

entries.name: Regaining grit
entries: 1 point when you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack with a firearm.
1 point when you deal a killing blow with a firearm to a creature of significant threat (your GM's call).
From level 18, also on a roll of 19 or 20 on a firearm attack (Vicious Intent).
All spent grit returns when you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Spending grit
entries: Trick shots cost 1 point each — Violent Shot can take several. From level 10, repairing a jammed firearm as a bonus action costs 1 point (Rapid Repair).

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play. See Trick Shots.

variantrule.name: Trick Shots
entries: A Gunslinger's trick shots, paid for out of grit.

entries.name: Using one
entries: Declared before the attack roll, and only one per attack.
Save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Learning them
entries: Two at Gunslinger level 3, and another at levels 7, 10, 15 and 18. Each time you learn one you may also swap one you already know.

entries.name: Bullying Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit. The blast and the noise do the talking: you gain Advantage on a Charisma (Intimidation) check.

entries.name: Dazing Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit, on a firearm attack. On a hit: normal damage, and the target makes a Constitution saving throw or attacks at Disadvantage until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Deadeye Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit, on a firearm attack. You gain Advantage on the attack roll.

entries.name: Disarming Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit, on a firearm attack. On a hit: normal damage, and the target makes a Strength saving throw or drops one held object of your choice, which is pushed 10 feet away from you.

entries.name: Forceful Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit, on a firearm attack. On a hit: normal damage, and the target makes a Strength saving throw or is pushed 15 feet away from you.

entries.name: Piercing Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit, on a firearm attack, and +1 to the weapon's misfire score for this attack. On a hit: normal damage, then an attack roll with Disadvantage against every creature in a line directly behind the target, within your first range increment. Only the first attack can misfire.

entries.name: Violent Shot
entries: Cost: 1 or more grit, on a firearm attack, and +2 to the weapon's misfire score for each point spent. On a hit: one extra weapon damage die per point spent.

entries.name: Winging Shot
entries: Cost: 1 grit, on a firearm attack. On a hit: normal damage, and the target makes a Strength saving throw or is knocked prone.

entries.name: Where this comes from
entries: From the Gunslinger (1.3) by Matt Mercer, summarised for play.
